system: CHARACTER STATS + LEVEL-UP ALLOCATION (stats screen, stat points, titles/class display)
summary: Six integer stats (STR/DEF/VIT/LCK/AGI/INT) start at 0. Leveling grants exactly 1 unallocated stat point per level (max level 30, EXP = 200*1.75^(lvl-1), cascading multi-level-ups in one grant). Player presses C to toggle a right-aligned CHARACTER window (also closable with ESC or click-outside) showing three columns: STATS (with +1 buttons when points remain), TITLES (last 8 earned, tier-colored, passive bonuses — no equip/select mechanic), and PROGRESS (bars toward next unearned title per activity). Clicking a +1 button calls allocate_stat_point which increments the stat, decrements the pool, and re-runs recalculate_stats (max HP/mana = base 100 + VIT*15 / INT*20 + class + equipment; current HP/mana rescaled proportionally). There is NO respec — allocation is permanent. Per-stat scaling magnitudes load from Definitions.JSON/stats-calculations.JSON characterStatModifiers at module import with hardcoded fallbacks. Class is chosen once on a mandatory ESC-proof selection screen and shown in the HUD side panel; titles are auto-awarded by requirement checks (some RNG-gated) and stack additively via get_total_bonus.

mechanics: Level-up: add_exp accumulates, then loops while current_exp >= next requirement — subtracts requirement, level+=1, unallocated_stat_points+=1 per level, cascades multiple levels in one call; returns whether any level occurred; no EXP gain at max level (leveling.py:24-49)
EXP table precomputed dict for levels 1-30: int(200 * 1.75^(lvl-1)); get_exp_for_next_level returns 0 at max level (leveling.py:8-13)
Level-up publishes LEVEL_UP event {new_level, stat_points, source} on event bus and records to stat_tracker (leveling.py:38-48)
Allocation: allocate_stat_point(stat_name) — refuses if pool <= 0; uses hasattr on CharacterStats then setattr +1, pool -=1, calls recalculate_stats(); returns bool (character.py:733-741)

recalculate_stats: max_health = base_max_health(100) + VIT*15 (get_flat_bonus) + class max_health bonus + equipment max_health; max_mana = base_max_mana(100) + INT*20 + class + equipment (character.py:703-723, character.py:113-114)
HP/mana rescale on recompute: current = min(new_max, int(new_max * old_current/old_max)) — proportional, only if old max > 0 (character.py:725-731)
No respec/deallocate mechanic exists anywhere — only +1 allocation (verified: no respec/unallocate code paths; character.py:733-741 is the sole mutation)
CharacterStats dataclass: strength/defense/vitality/luck/agility/intelligence, all default 0 (stats.py:102-109)
get_bonus(stat) = value * per-stat scaling from JSON (fallbacks: STR .05, DEF .02, VIT .01, LCK .02, AGI .05, INT .02); unknown stat name defaults to 0.05 scaling (stats.py:111-113, stats.py:21-24)
get_flat_bonus(stat, type) = value * flat table (STR: carry_capacity 10 + inventory_slots 10; VIT: max_health 15; INT: mana 20) (stats.py:115-118, stats.py:26-30)

JSON mapping: meleeDamagePerPoint→STR, damageReductionPerPoint→DEF, healthRegenPerPoint→VIT, critChancePerPoint→LCK, forestryDamagePerPoint→AGI, reductionPerPoint→INT; inventorySlotsPerPoint→STR flat (both keys), maxHPPerPoint→VIT flat, maxManaPerPoint→INT flat; any exception returns full fallbacks (stats.py:33-86)
Config loaded once at import into module globals; reload_stat_config() re-reads for designer hot-reload (stats.py:89-99)

Derived helpers: durability-loss mult = max(0.1, 1 - DEF*0.02); max-durability mult = 1 + VIT*0.01; carry-capacity mult = 1 + STR*0.02; effective luck = LCK + title_bonus + skill_bonus + rare_drop_bonus/0.02 (stats.py:120-178)
AGI move speed: +1.5% per point (separate from the 3% attack speed in JSON), composed with class + buff bonuses (character.py:784-785)
VIT health regen: after 5s without dealing/taking damage, regen = health_regen_rate * (1 + VIT*0.01) * dt; mana regen flat 1% max_mana/sec always (character.py:1426-1455)

Combat crit: chance uses _LCK_CRIT_PER_POINT = 0.12 per LCK point (env-overridable CRUX_LCK_CRIT_PER_POINT), NOT the JSON 0.02 used for the stats-screen display (combat_manager.py:21-24, renderer.py:7623-7624)

Stats-screen render returns (window_rect, [(button_rect, stat_name)]) each frame; engine stores them for click hit-testing in window-relative coords (renderer.py:7619-7633, game_engine.py:8755-8761, game_engine.py:3244-3255)

Title awarding: check_for_title iterates all title defs, skips earned, evaluates requirements, then by acquisition_method: guaranteed_milestone/hidden_discovery always award; event_based_rng/special_achievement award at generation_chance; legacy random_drop uses tier chances novice 1.0/apprentice .20/journeyman .10/expert .05/master .02 (title_system.py:58-107)

Title bonuses sum across ALL earned titles (first matching key candidate per title); non-numeric values skipped; key resolution tolerates camelCase→snake_case, renames (smithing_time→smithing_speed, refining_precision→refining_speed, critical_chance→crit_chance) and the 'elemental_afinity' data typo (title_system.py:17-31, title_system.py:109-140)
TITLE_EARNED published to event bus on award; class selection records class_changed and fills HP/mana to new max (title_system.py:47-55, character.py:1526-1530, game_engine.py:3202-3211)

hazards: Display vs combat LCK mismatch: stats screen shows '+2%/pt' (JSON critChancePerPoint 0.02 via get_bonus) but actual combat crit uses 0.12/pt module constant — preserve both as-is (renderer.py:7623-7624, combat_manager.py:24, stats-calculations.JSON:460)

Quest stat_points reward is effectively dead: it checks character.stat_points then character.unallocated_points — Character has NEITHER (real field is character.leveling.unallocated_stat_points), so hasattr fails twice and the reward is skipped with a debug print; the first branch would also shadow-create a plain attribute via +=. Preserve the no-op or consciously fix (quest_system.py:197-210, leveling.py:10)
allocate_stat_point uses hasattr(self.stats, stat_name) — ANY existing attribute name on CharacterStats would pass; stat names must be the lowercase field names exactly (character.py:736-737)
get_bonus/get_flat_bonus lowercase the stat name and default unknown scaling to 0.05 — a typo'd stat silently yields +5%/pt, not an error (stats.py:111-118)
JSON scaling is read ONCE at module import into module globals; mid-game edits require reload_stat_config(); any parse error silently reverts ALL values to fallbacks (stats.py:84-99)
INT maxManaPerPoint is absent from the current JSON, so mana/pt=20 comes from the code fallback — porting only the JSON loses it (stats-calculations.JSON:377-438, stats.py:29)

HP/mana proportional rescale uses int() truncation and min() clamp — allocating VIT while damaged does NOT heal proportional HP loss-free; order: health ratio computed from OLD max before overwrite (character.py:719-731)
Stat allocation does NOT go through recalculating derived combat values beyond max HP/mana — STR/LCK/AGI/DEF effects are read live at use-time from stats (character.py:703-741)

+1 buttons exist only while unallocated_stat_points > 0; button rects are rebuilt every rendered frame and hit-tested in window-relative coordinates (subtract window x/y) (renderer.py:7627-7633, game_engine.py:3247-3251)
Points line shifts stat rows down by 25px when visible — button rects move accordingly; hit-testing must use the same frame's rects (renderer.py:7614-7617)

Titles have no active/equipped slot: all earned titles stack additively; get_total_bonus takes only the FIRST matching key candidate per title and skips non-numeric bonus values (title_system.py:118-128)
Title key normalization: JSON camelCase → snake_case with semantic renames and a deliberate typo-tolerance for 'elementalAfinity' in shipped data — do not 'fix' the data key (title_system.py:17-26)

ESC close priority is a strict elif chain (interactive crafting > chests > crafting > stats > equipment > skills > encyclopedia > map > class-warning > NPC dialogue > pause menu) — reproduce the ordering (game_engine.py:810-853)
Opening stats via C closes other overlay panels (mutual exclusivity) and records menu analytics; click-outside closes without analytics symmetry (game_engine.py:861-867, game_engine.py:2552-2555)
Class selection is mandatory and ESC-proof (shows a notification instead of closing); selecting a class refills HP/mana to full (game_engine.py:836-840, character.py:1526-1530)
Level-up cascade fix (2026-07): multiple thresholds resolve in one add_exp call; LEVEL_UP event fires once PER LEVEL with the running total of unallocated points, not the delta (leveling.py:28-48)

Progress column recomputes 'next title' by scanning ALL titles per activity for lowest unearned threshold above current count each frame; mining/forestry rows show even at count 0 (renderer.py:7664-7675)
PROGRESS column caps at 5 activities via activities_shown set checked BEFORE add — order of the hardcoded activity list determines which show (renderer.py:7664-7676)
